principle: Equality or difference of hashes is NEVER, by itself, sufficient proof of copy or rebuild. Provenance requires canonical sources, exact commands, captured compiler identity, environment allow-list, timestamps and transcripts; acceptance always uses CONTROLLER-built outputs.
controller_rules: controller uses an EMPTY build directory for every controlled rebuild
canonical source inputs come from the candidate (C..R owned paths)
compiler absolute path (realpath) and version recorded
ELF metadata recorded where an ELF output exists
dynamic dependencies recorded where an ELF output exists
acceptance uses controller-built outputs (never leaf binaries)
tracked ELF rejected (binaries must not be tracked in R)

LAB-A.rule: LAB-A declares leaf_build_claim.status=not_applicable; compiler_path/compiler_version/commands/outputs must be null/empty; invented compiler or output fields are REJECTED
LAB-A.controlled_rebuild: not_applicable (justified: no buildable output in LAB-A scope)

LAB-B.rule: LAB-B leaf_build_claim is a CLAIM ONLY: sources/commands/outputs/compiler_path/compiler_version/transcript_sha256 must be structurally present; the controller verifies the claim by controlled rebuild in full-completion phase
LAB-B.controlled_rebuild: PASS required in full-completion; controller rebuilds from canonical sources in an empty build dir using the frozen build command and verifies output SHA-256 equals the claimed value

hash_policy: hash equality/difference is supporting evidence only; never sufficient proof of copy or rebuild
